column5: ✅ THE ONE GAME THAT AGREES. All five canonical payout tables are byte-identical across client PlinkoGame.tsx:137, PlinkoTypes.ts:47, points-game:195, game-settlement:2488 and the Go chain plinkoBPS in gaming_settle_models.go:612 (verified element-by-element across all 9 risk x row configs, not by eye). Bucket selection is server-authoritative on both live rails - POINTS from the provably-fair HMAC, on-chain from chain entropy - and the client Math.random path is cosmetic, discarded before payout. Measured edge ~1% on every config, baked into the table and applied exactly once. ★ CAVEAT 1: a SIXTH copy in gridGamesService.ts:753 has low/12 wrong in 11 of 13 buckets, giving a 31.2% edge against the canonical 1.02%; it is DEAD (no production importer) but also mints serverSeed in the browser, so it must never be wired up. ★ CAVEAT 2: the parity test PlinkoGame.test.ts declares CLIENT_MULTIPLIERS and SERVER_MULTIPLIERS as two hardcoded literals INSIDE the test and compares them to each other, never importing either real source - which is exactly how the gridGames divergence survived. No _shared/plinko.ts exists, unlike every other game
